block.campfiremons.diamond_tipped_crushi: A _Crushing Wheel_ with diamond tips. Pair it with another one to crush _faster_ and get _more bonus outputs_.

Crushes _50% faster_ at the same speed, and every _chance output_ gets _25 points_ more (75% becomes 100%): _more crushed ore_ from ore blocks, and the _XP nugget_ always drops. Paired with a normal wheel, it crushes like a normal wheel.
